authority.source_authority: DAD retains authority for its contracts and registries; generated pilot evidence remains candidate-only and Lowell retains product, activation, release, and promotion authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only implementation-worker may edit the approved project-management, trigger, feedback, registry, documentation, and test files; scout and checker are read-only, while the root foreman writes only task-local mesh revisions and integrates accepted evidence.

roles.why_needed: Existing project, workflow, trigger, graph, skill, and test contracts must be mapped before extending them.
roles.mission: Inventory the narrowest reusable contracts, consumers, validators, and collision risks for the AI-native process pilot.
roles.authority: Read-only inventory and recommendations; cannot edit files or approve implementation.
acceptance_conditions: Returns exact reusable paths and consumers.
Identifies duplicate or conflicting schema, role, and trigger concepts.
Names the smallest coherent implementation slice.
stop_conditions: Private or external payloads would be required.

readiness_conditions: Relevant local registries, schemas, skills, and tests were inspected.

roles.why_needed: One bounded writer must implement the coupled contract, role, metrics, trigger specifications, and pilot evidence coherently.
roles.mission: Implement the smallest DAD-native manual AI process pilot by extending the existing project-management specialist pack, trigger specifications, usage feedback, documentation, and focused contract tests without creating a new schema, CLI, ledger, scheduler, or cockpit authority.
roles.authority: May edit only the approved project-management skill and reference files, trigger routine and contract files, asset-use feedback template and documentation, minimal skill-library metadata, and focused tests in this worktree; no external or cross-repo writes.
acceptance_conditions: Routine-purpose, build-refusal, experience-surface, learning-velocity, and usage/findability contracts are explicit and machine-tested.
Product catalyst is a bounded specialist inside the existing project-management family.
Candidate triggers include suppressors, quiet conditions, human gates, validators, and negative cases.
The manual pilot has bounded entry, exit, kill, attention, and evidence rules.
Focused tests and DAD validation pass.
stop_conditions: Implementation would require changing source authority or enabling automation.
A conflicting canonical contract cannot be reconciled without human choice.
Write scope overlaps another active writer.

readiness_conditions: Worker tests pass and the diff is limited to the approved scope.

roles.why_needed: The worker cannot approve a new governance contract, agent role, trigger pattern, or pilot harness.
roles.mission: Independently verify contract invariants, role boundaries, trigger suppressors, registry consistency, privacy, one-human ergonomics, and regression evidence without demanding a duplicate schema or execution surface.
roles.authority: Read-only independent review; cannot edit worker files, promote candidates, activate routines, or release changes.
acceptance_conditions: Re-runs focused and baseline validation independently.
Tests negative cases, collision boundaries, and false-authority paths.
Reports release gate, defects, untested paths, and residual risks.
stop_conditions: Checker authored a material implementation file.
Required source evidence or deterministic validators are unavailable.

readiness_conditions: Final diff and raw validation outputs are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove the implementation extends existing DAD contracts without creating a duplicate authority surface.
Prove no trigger, routine, product recommendation, or pilot result can mutate active systems or self-promote.
Prove the pilot remains usable by one human with bounded decisions, quiet conditions, expiry, and cost visibility.

reconciliations.reason: The scout completed the planned read-only inventory and retained its original boundary.
The writer remains necessary, but inventory evidence narrowed its mission away from a duplicate schema, CLI, ledger, scheduler, and cockpit surface.
evidence_refs: existing Portfolio OS and trigger contracts

reconciliations.reason: The checker remains independent; its inputs and proof targets were narrowed to contract invariants and collision boundaries.
